name: Light
desc: Stored light. Abilities spend it; it refills slowly on its own and quickly at your base.

name: Tally
desc: Builds as you attack, take hits and land abilities. Some abilities spend it. It drains after a few seconds out of combat.

name: Heat
desc: Abilities add Heat instead of spending it. A full bar overheats you: no abilities for a moment while it vents. It cools when you stop casting.

name: Unlit
desc: No resource. Abilities are limited by their cooldowns alone.
